facilities.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent building sprite atlas. Visual art direction: original hand-crafted low-color pixel art for a mature 16-bit / HD-2D road survival JRPG. Earth, specifically East Asia, has been occupied for ten years. Restrained faded beige plaster, muted moss green, rusty brown, dusty slate-blue, charcoal violet alien additions. Cream light from UPPER LEFT, cool blue-grey shadows on RIGHT surfaces. Small sparse amber or jade signal lamps, never excessive neon. Visible hand-selected pixel clusters, crisp stepped outlines, thoughtful dithering, clean readable silhouette. Believable worn materials and depth, but NOT a photograph, NOT smooth 3D, NOT photoreal, NOT Minecraft blocks. Camera is a SHALLOW SIDE VIEW with slight elevation: see FRONT and RIGHT SIDE wall plus ROOF planes. This is dimensional game sprite art, not flat orthographic icons and not extreme top-down isometric.
Create one panoramic 3:1 image, ideally 2304x768, with EXACT FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of eight separate complete BUILDINGS. Each sprite centered in equal cell, visibly separated by generous truly transparent space, no overlap, no grid lines, no words or numbers. Transparent alpha background is mandatory. No matte/checkerboard, no painted background, no distant scenery, no characters, no vehicles. Each building sits on a thin little foundation footprint, no huge ground island and no cast shadow outside the object. Keep all building baselines consistent. No sprite touches cell boundary.
Each building must have a unique practical silhouette, recognizable East Asian roadside architecture, aged occupied-world details, survivor repairs. Alien occupation should be a subordinate but visible graft: one small angular charcoal-violet monitor, clamp or antenna, sparse amber indicator lights. Not giant identical crescent ornaments on every roof.
Eight sprites row-major:
1 GAS: low weathered East Asian filling station, flat canopy with visible roof plane, 2 vintage pumps, small office with sliding glass door and patched teal fascia. No lettering.
2 GARAGE: wide corrugated metal workshop, tall open rolling shutter, right wall with external pipes and spare machinery, sloping roof and tiny rooftop alien monitor.
3 MOTEL: two-storey compact roadside motel, square concrete balconies, exterior stairway on right, rooftop water tank, patched air conditioners, a few warmly lit windows. No signage text.
4 CLINIC: modest pale beige medical clinic, asymmetric porch awning, green cross symbol, right-side annex and oxygen cylinders, simple warm doorway.
5 PHARMACY: narrow East Asian pharmacy storefront, green awning, glass display of bottles, right brick party wall, rolled shutter, small cross symbol, distinct from clinic.
6 WAREHOUSE: broad old industrial warehouse, layered rusted pitched roof, loading platform and offset sliding door, concrete side wall, several crates clustered at rear, small alien control clamp.
7 SHOP: small family general store, tiled roof and patched canvas awning, baskets, wooden shutter windows, right extension made of sheet metal, warm lantern at entrance. No signs or writing.
8 CHECKPOINT: imposing alien occupation checkpoint built around human road booth: asymmetrical dark charcoal-violet armored arch with segmented ribs, lowered barrier and searchlamp, sparse amber signal strips, a wedge-shaped right control tower. Recognizably invasive nonhuman structure with dimensional armor.
Pixel sprite style, elegant restrained palette, upper-left lighting, right-side cool shadow, transparent gaps, 8 complete isolated different objects. No text, labels, frames, UI, people or cars.

roadside.prompt:

Visual art direction: original hand-crafted low-color pixel art for a mature 16-bit / HD-2D road survival JRPG. Earth, specifically East Asia, has been occupied for ten years. Restrained faded beige plaster, muted moss green, rusty brown, dusty slate-blue, charcoal violet alien additions. Cream light from UPPER LEFT, cool blue-grey shadows on RIGHT surfaces. Small sparse amber or jade signal lamps, never excessive neon. Visible hand-selected pixel clusters, crisp stepped outlines, thoughtful dithering, clean readable silhouette. Believable worn materials and depth, but NOT a photograph, NOT smooth 3D, NOT photoreal, NOT Minecraft blocks. Camera is a SHALLOW SIDE VIEW with slight elevation: see FRONT and RIGHT SIDE wall plus ROOF planes. This is dimensional game sprite art, not flat orthographic icons and not extreme top-down isometric.
Create one image with EXACT THREE COLUMNS and THREE ROWS of NINE separate complete roadside facility sprites, row-major order below. Overall landscape 3:2, ideally 1536x1024; equal grid cells. No sprite crosses cell edges. Generous transparent gutters, TRUE transparent alpha background, no opaque backdrop or checkerboard. No grid lines, names, letters or numbers. No people or cars. Every sprite complete, baseline near bottom of its cell, compact ground contact footprint. Clear three-dimensional silhouette with visible top and right-side faces, upper-left cream light and cool right shadows. Original low-color pixel sprite art, NOT photographic.
Nine sprites in exact order:
ROW 1 LEFT STALL: tiny scavenger's wooden cart stall with patched canvas canopy and several supply boxes, side counter and dangling lantern, compact welcoming silhouette.
ROW 1 MIDDLE MARKET: larger roadside survivor market arcade, two connected mismatched awnings, metal shutters, hanging unmarked baskets and supplies, taller than stall but not a full warehouse, improvised alien scanner.
ROW 1 RIGHT TOLL: abandoned East Asian highway toll booth, small glass cabin, long red-white barrier arm, flat gantry with blank sign panels, broken camera replaced by small alien sensor, visible side wall.
ROW 2 LEFT BRIDGE: short damaged span of concrete road bridge presented as an isolated landmark, one gap in deck, distinct railings, supporting pier and exposed steel beneath, compact enough to fit cell; no river, no background landscape.
ROW 2 MIDDLE TUNNEL: concrete road tunnel entrance embedded in a compact rocky portal structure, dark archway and visible right rocky face, a few muted amber safety lights, alien sensor above lintel. No long receding road.
ROW 2 RIGHT CAMP: compact refugee camp with one patched khaki canvas tent, folded tarp shelter, metal stove, water containers and a tiny solar panel, no people, not a building.
ROW 3 LEFT SCRAPYARD: small fenced scrapyard landmark, piles of old machinery, 2 dismantled chassis and rusted metal panels behind sagging wire fence, corrugated shed with visible side wall, no intact usable car.
ROW 3 MIDDLE MEMORIAL: weathered East Asian roadside stone memorial, low stone plinth with blank engraved tablet, small paper offerings, two broken lanterns and weeds, restrained solemn silhouette, no legible text.
ROW 3 RIGHT SOLAR: human roadside solar relay station, 3 angled solar panels with visible metal frames, squat utility cabinet, old radio mast, one small black-violet occupation clamp and a few jade signal lights.
All nine visually distinct subjects, true transparency, no captions or signs with letters, no UI. Preserve pixel-art volume with roof/top/right planes.

interiors.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art indoor background atlas. Visual art direction: original hand-crafted low-color pixel art for a mature 16-bit / HD-2D road survival JRPG. Earth, specifically East Asia, has been occupied for ten years. Restrained faded beige plaster, muted moss green, rusty brown, dusty slate-blue, charcoal violet alien additions. Cream light from UPPER LEFT, cool blue-grey shadows on RIGHT surfaces. Small sparse amber or jade signal lamps, never excessive neon. Visible hand-selected pixel clusters, crisp stepped outlines, thoughtful dithering, clean readable silhouette. Believable worn materials and depth, but NOT a photograph, NOT smooth 3D, NOT photoreal, NOT Minecraft blocks. Camera is a SHALLOW SIDE VIEW with slight elevation: see FRONT and RIGHT SIDE wall plus ROOF planes. This is dimensional game sprite art, not flat orthographic icons and not extreme top-down isometric.
Create EXACTLY EIGHT full-bleed rectangular room backgrounds in an EXACT TWO-COLUMN by FOUR-ROW grid. OUTPUT MUST BE SQUARE 1:1, e.g. 1536x1536 or 1024x1024. This makes EACH individual room a wide 2:1 panorama. Do not output a landscape atlas. No gaps, borders, labels, lettering or UI. Each scene contained in its own rectangle, equal cell sizes.
Camera shallow side view looking toward REAR AND RIGHT WALL, so rooms have real depth and visible side planes; not top-down. Main light warm cream from upper left windows/fixtures; right corners cool muted blue-grey. Low-saturation carefully clustered pixel art, worn East Asian architecture, ten years after alien occupation. Human rooms have subtle alien black-violet monitoring devices or parasitic conduits with sparse amber/teal indicators. Do not repeat gigantic crescent forms. No characters, no enemies, no vehicles. Most furniture stays along back and side walls. Bottom 30% of EVERY ROOM is clear unobstructed floor for runtime actors and event props.
Eight rooms in exact reading order:
ROW1 LEFT WAREHOUSE: long concrete storage room, steel shelf bays against back and right wall, old wooden crates and folded tarps, high dusty clerestory windows, quiet amber ceiling lamp, small alien conduit near roof.
ROW1 RIGHT CLINIC: humble clinic with faded mint tile, single empty examination bed along left/back wall, sink and medicine cabinet, patched curtain at right, no people, soft cream daylight and cold sterile shadows.
ROW2 LEFT GARAGE: corrugated East Asian repair workshop, toolboard, rusty lift posts at edges, hose reels, oil-marked floor and high window, alien battery adapter on rear workbench, no car.
ROW2 RIGHT SHOP: dim warm family general store, worn wood and canned goods on orderly back shelves, low counter along right wall, patched canvas ceiling, compact alien sensor, no lettering.
ROW3 LEFT HOTEL: modest East Asian roadside inn lobby with patterned faded walls, small reception desk at rear/right, old wooden room doors, wicker chair at left, warm paper-shade lamp, repairs and one cold alien wire along wall.
ROW3 RIGHT LABORATORY: appropriated human lab with grey cabinets, cracked tile and glass equipment, a black-violet observation mechanism integrated into ceiling and 2 amber sample tanks at back, restrained glow, no creatures in foreground.
ROW4 LEFT RUIN: broken concrete room with roof damage and upper-left sunlight, rubble restricted to sides, empty dusty central floor, an old window revealing a faint occupied skyline, right wall partially collapsed.
ROW4 RIGHT NEST: derelict human room slowly engulfed in alien roots and small fungal growths on back/right walls, a few dim jade bioluminescent caps and amber sacs, dark muted organic materials, clear central lower floor, no creatures.
No text, labels, grids, frames, characters, enemies or UI. Beautiful dimensional hand-made low-color pixel environment art, not heavily oversaturated and not a smooth rendering.

rect_generation: tools/build_volume_buildings.py reads raw PNG with standard-library zlib; no image editing. Tight rectangles follow entire alpha-connected components, excluding atlas gaps and avoiding neighbour contamination. Interior rectangles exclude border pixels.
inspection: All 17 facility subjects and 8 interior subjects visually checked. Both exterior PNGs have a true RGBA alpha channel with fully transparent gutters; hidden RGB values in the transparent roadside gutters are immaterial to rendering.
